description: Sample and hold that draws its samples from an internal simplex noise source rather than from a patched signal

params.text: Sets how fast the module travels through the noise, 1% to 100%, so how far apart in the noise two consecutive samples fall

inputs.text: A rising edge takes a new sample, and the number of channels here sets the number of channels at the output
0-10V scales the travel speed set by the speed knob, 0V freezing the travel and 10V giving the full knob speed

outputs.text: The value held since the last trigger, mapped into the voltage range picked on the menu

notes: the output carries the last sample taken and nothing else, so it is 0V until a rising edge reaches the trigger jack.
menu: range — sets the voltage span of the output: twelve presets from +/-10V to 0V-1V, or custom for a minimum and maximum of your own; it starts at -1V to 1V
